text:
samira.h: Hey all, first day — I accepted the Okta invite but the MFA step fails with 'No compatible authenticator found'. I'm on the company Fedora dev VM (browser is Chromium in a sandbox) and can't seem to register a passkey. Anyone seen this on Linux VMs?

olivia-peopleops: Welcome Samira! :wave: We usually see that when device forwarding in the VM blocks CTAP/U2F or when libfido2 isn't available. Two quick options: 1) use TOTP in 1Password as a fallback, 2) register a phone as a security key (if the VM can reach your phone via QR/nearby flow). If neither works I'll temporarily change your Okta enrollment policy so you can finish onboarding.

sam-it: On Fedora you may need libfido2 and chrome-gnome-keyring integration for platform authenticators. If you're on a locked-down VM the USB/CTAP stack is often not exposed. Workarounds:
- Option A: Open the invite link on your personal laptop/phone, enroll the passkey there, then come back to the VM and use TOTP.
- Option B: Enroll TOTP now (1Password/Authy). I can also generate a one-time backup code from the admin console to get you past the step.
- If you want to try installing libs: `sudo dnf install libfido2 libfido2-devel` and restart Chromium, but that may be blocked on the managed image.

samira.h: Tried opening the invite on my phone, but the flow expects a 'Use a security key' click in the VM browser and the VM can't detect my phone since there's no device forwarding. Phone QR flow didn't appear.

sam-it: Got it. That's the VM sandboxing biting us. I'll flip your Okta policy to allow 'Authenticator app' only for 24h so you can finish onboarding with TOTP. Also queuing a SCIM push for 1Password now.

okta-bot: Admin action: enrollment policy override applied for user samira.h@redwood.com. TTL: 24h.

olivia-peopleops: Shipping note: I scheduled an express YubiKey to your address (tracking SHT123456789us). If you prefer no hardware, that's fine — we just like having a second factor option available.

maria-eng: Welcome! :wave: Once Okta is ACTIVE I'll add you to the infra Google Drive + GitHub teams. If you need VPN/bastion access, DM me your SSH pubkey and I'll kick off the PR to our keys repo.

samira.h: TOTP worked — enrolled via 1Password and Okta now shows ACTIVE. 1Password invite arrived a minute after the SCIM push. Thanks for the quick help and for shipping the key!

olivia-peopleops: Great to hear. Marking resolved — if anyone else is on a locked VM or uses a managed Linux image, ping #new-hires and we can do a quick policy override or ship a hardware key. :tada:
